_comment: Square hold-ground reform on rally. A SQUARE player infantry block (60 men, which square_files lays out at 8 files -- seven full ranks plus a centred 4-man rear rank) is staged already routing, with the enemy still a long way off. Same staging as row-major-rally-reform.json and for the same reason: a rout that happens IN contact gets pinned by enemy soldier-body pressure and ground down rather than pulling clear, so it shatters instead of rallying. Here nothing is inside the rally-contact radius, so its morale climbs back toward the rout baseline and it re-forms where it stands. It rallies at about 100 wu/s at tick 200 (60 Hz dump basis), so it first pulls up over about 75 wu with its men braking in step (the anchor stops at tick 300), and stands near y=493 from about tick 400. The flee turn folds _formation_angle to PI, and the rally's reform_ranks(hold_ground = true) then arms the depth reflection. The square branch used to have nothing cancelling that reflection -- its slots come from _sim_soldier_square_slot rather than the row-major array, so neither the file-major rank reversal nor the row-major cell pairing applied -- and every man walked the block's full depth through the oncoming half. The square grid is built by the same block_slots generator, so the same cell pairing cancels it on the square's own assignment array: by design 56 of the 60 hold their ground, and only the four men whose lateral position has no counterpart in the centred 4-man rank swap ends. Measured, though, 55 of the 60 stand nearer another man's slot than their own for about 50 ticks after the rally (to about tick 250) before they settle onto their own; that transient is tracked in #1766 and declared as the misslotted exemption below. A second, safe player unit well out of the rout-shock radius keeps the battle from declaring defeat while the infantry is routing. The router spawns at morale 22 rather than 5: a router now flees at its real flee pace, so the later rally the old staging gave carried the block off this camera and past the far-tier demotion range before it could re-form.

overlap.reason: Same residual as row-major-rally-reform.json, on the square's own assignment array: the four men whose lateral position has no counterpart in the centred 4-man rank have no cell to pair with, so they swap ends and cross the stationary ranks between. The rally is at tick 200. On 2-tick samples the closest body pair is under the 2.25 wu floor from tick 212 to tick 302 (worst 0.298 wu at tick 284), against a worst of 0.054 wu on main 1f4a77eb, where the anchor stopped dead on the rally; the block is back on its 9.0 wu lattice from tick 304. Tracked in #1772.

misslotted.reason: After the rally at tick 200, 55 of the 60 men stand nearer another man's slot than their own until about tick 250 (misslotted 0.917 on the settled 2-tick samples at ticks 236, 238 and 240; 0.15 from tick 260). The fraction is the same on main 1f4a77eb (0.85 to 0.90 from tick 200 to 310), where it is masked: there the anchor stopped dead and the men ran on past their slots, so only one sample counts as settled. With the rally halt the block pulls up in step and stands on the grid sooner, so those samples are judged. Tracked in #1766.
